name: 22556 · Stafford, VA
findings: ZIP 22556 (Stafford) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22556 (Stafford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 22556 (Stafford) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
